title: chichewa-school-intent-classifier-dataset
subtitle: Labeled Chichewa school messages for 8 intent classes.
description: Private dataset of Chichewa (plus school English) messages labeled as fees, admissions, results, general_information, password_reset, timetable, attendance, or courses. Used to fine-tune Afro-XLMR. Code lives on GitHub. This Kaggle dataset stays private until I publish it.
